subject: ist-f
title: IST.F.------AFL.DY.-----AFI.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 465 (MP(I)-39). IST-F (isolated focus) is the subject, with the (D) prefix, "the dynamics of". The title names AFL-DY (affinity dynamics); the chart has no label for it. The title names AFI (affinity insight); the chart has no label for it. From the subject: AFI-1 (affinity insight—first degree). From AFI-1: COS-P (cosmic particulars), ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and LANG-DY (language dynamics). CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) is on a dotted line from AFI-1. From COS-P: PER-TR (perceived transformation).
